Title: Mortal Kombat series
Source: GamingBolt (quoting WB Games press release for MK1 reveal)
Note: Warner Bros. Games said the series had sold over 80 million copies when it revealed Mortal Kombat 1 in May 2023, as reported by GamingBolt. Mortal Kombat 1's own sales came later, so they aren't in it.

Title: Mortal Kombat 11
Source: Warner Bros. Games press release (MK 30th anniversary)
Note: Warner Bros. Games' own figure, announced for the series' 30th anniversary in October 2022.

Title: Mortal Kombat 1
Note: NetherRealm announced it had passed 8 million in April 2026, as reported by Nintendo Life. It came out after the series' 80 million count, so it sits past the end of that bar.

Title: Mortal Kombat X
Source: EventHubs (Ed Boon, NetherRealm, Game Informer interview)

Title: Super Smash Bros. series
Source: No official or analyst figure found
Note: Nintendo only publishes sales game by game, never for the whole series. The bar adds up the four games it reports; the first two Smash games have no figure we could trace back to Nintendo.

Source: Nintendo IR - Top Selling Title Sales Units (Switch)
Note: Nintendo's worldwide count of copies sold, downloads and console bundles included, from its investor site as of September 30, 2026.

Source: Nintendo IR - Top Selling Title Sales Units (Wii)

Source: Nintendo IR - Top Selling Title Sales Units (Wii U)

Note: Bandai Namco's count of console and PC copies shipped, from its 2026 Fact Book, as of March 31, 2026. Arcade machines and mobile games aren't included.
